children: Zeo ScientifiX and Pluri agreed to expand U.S. manufacturing and commercialization of regenerative medicine products through a partnership that combines Zeo ScientifiX's biologics business and physician network with Pluri's cell-expansion technology. At closing, Pluri is expected to own 50% of Zeo ScientifiX's outstanding common shares and receive preferred shares with voting and protective rights, as well as warrants for additional shares. In exchange, Zeo ScientifiX will receive an exclusive U.S. license to manufacture and commercialize Pluri's regenerative medicine portfolio, with royalties based on net sales. Closing is expected in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to conditions.
